item.title: Standard Bank boost Southern Guards global push
item.description: Standard Bank has joined forces with Southern Guards GC, the team flying the South African flag on the global LIV Golf stage. The partnership pairs the financial powerhouse with a rising force in international sport, united in their drive to elevate South Africa’s global presence. item.description: South Africa’s Danielle Du Toit secured her second Sunshine Ladies Tour title on Saturday after winning the Standard Bank Ladies Open hosted by The City of Cape Town at Durbanville Golf Club.
